authority_required: User confirmation to replace work-order section 1.5 host admission threshold; all other work-order constraints remain in force.

proposed_execution.geometry: Read only matching tile centre/normal/patch_id fields; retain only supplied building patches; release each tile before the next.
proposed_execution.visibility: Reuse v1 projection helpers; read required point data in bounded chunks and retain only the section crop.
proposed_execution.rendering: Render and close one figure per subprocess; first figure is also the measured memory pilot.
proposed_execution.postprocess_detection: Read current LOSSTRAIN TSDF lock occupancy and active postprocess containers before and during each stage. Do not hold the shared lock or alter the training task.
proposed_execution.yield_behavior: If host availability falls below 16 GiB, or TSDF/large scoring begins, stop only this task's active figure container, retain its logs, mark incomplete output invalid, and wait. Never stop or pause training or postprocessing.
proposed_execution.container_oom_behavior: Stop and report; do not automatically increase the 4 GiB limit.
proposed_execution.resume_behavior: Recheck admission and postprocess state; restart the incomplete figure from preserved inputs.
proposed_execution.measurement_values: Use supplied values without new optimization or photo-check evaluation.

limitations: V1 process RSS is not a V2 peak-memory guarantee and does not include every charged container page.
Host availability can change between samples; limits reduce interference but do not guarantee immunity from host-wide memory exhaustion.
